title: SM64DS Co-op menu preview.2 — Staff Roll background fix
notes:
Staff Roll now loops seven moving camera views through the DS courses, with half-second scene fades, no player or HUD, and your selected menu music continuing independently. Switching between Staff Roll and Bob-omb Battlefield correctly resets the background renderer even though both begin in the same course.

This follows CoopDX's menu credits behavior using original port camera paths through DS scenery; it does not run the retail DS ending script.

**Windows x86 preview:** open `sm64ds coop.exe` directly. Choose **Options > Display > Background > Staff Roll**. Replace only the executable in an existing installation and retain your assets, settings, saves and custom-media folders. No BAT launcher or media decoder DLL is required. The ZIP contains only the executable, README and license notices; supply your own supported game data.

Validation on source `8f4a1c6e727f7fe682933df565f0eb8bade74cc8`: full native build and DS-state/face-cycle/ARM9-global guards passed; 13 isolated runtime checks passed, including all seven moving cameras and the loop wrap, same-course switches, all eight backgrounds, all menu pages, DS music/SFX, custom media and a 120-frame gameplay check. Early/middle/late camera captures were inspected. All seven portable component/Windows-host jobs passed: https://github.com/SCOPIC64/sm64ds-coop-port/actions/runs/37964645377

Native Linux/SteamOS, macOS, Android and iOS game releases remain unavailable. Desktop portable component tests do not verify full games on those platforms. This remains a prerelease: fresh-folder import, adventure save loading, two-client co-op and return-to-menu need further runtime testing. Existing unrelated repository dead-reference and missing-private-assets/unsupported-parser CI failures remain documented in PR #5.
